Container.Name: ios-backup
Container.Overview: Scheduled iPhone/iPad backups straight to your array, over Wi-Fi - no Mac, no Windows VM. Makes standard Finder/iTunes (MobileBackup2) backups, so iMazing, Finder or iTunes can open them later, encrypted backups included. Built on pymobiledevice3. Pair each device once over USB (docker exec ios-backup ios-backup pair), then it reaches the phone over a RemotePairing Wi-Fi tunnel on your schedule. Encrypted backups need approving with the passcode on the phone when they start. Status page + Prometheus /metrics on port 9871, optional Discord alerts.
Container.Requires: Host networking (Bonjour discovery) and privileged mode (Wi-Fi tunnel TUN interface, USB access). A USB port on the server is needed once per device for pairing.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Each device gets a <UDID> folder in standard Finder/iTunes format

Config.Name: Pair records
Config.Description: Device pair records - these grant full access to the paired devices; keep this folder private

Config.Name: USB devices
Config.Description: For USB pairing and USB backups

Config.Name: Backup times
Config.Description: Comma-separated HH:MM (container TZ). Unreachable devices are retried every RETRY_MINUTES for RETRY_WINDOW_HOURS.

Config.Name: Backup days
Config.Description: Comma-separated days, e.g. sun or mon,thu. Blank = daily. Encrypted backups need approving on the phone, so pick a time you have it.

Config.Name: Discord webhook
Config.Description: Optional: alert on failed backups and when a backup needs approving on the phone

Config.Name: Only these UDIDs
Config.Description: Optional comma list; default = every paired device
